source_review.scope: Current source inspection; not a fresh source-to-deployed-binary rebuild proof
source_review.continuity_limit: Capture sequence counts API requests, not ADC samples. dropped_samples counts short reported buffer spans; there is no independent per-sample timestamp/counter.
source_review.refill_limit: adapter_capture_iq checks negative refill results but derives write length from buffer_end-buffer_start. Positive return/span disagreement is not explicitly rejected; actual libiio semantics and fault-injection coverage require separate validation.
source_review.transport_limit: Base64 carries bytes over ordered TCP and SigMF appends decoded bytes. No independent P201 payload hash is present in retained native reports; AGX inventory hashes prove preservation since sealing, not absence of pre-seal corruption.
